mechanismEstablished.cpuThrottlingReopened: gcloud run services describe hauska-engine-api shows NO run.googleapis.com/cpu-throttling annotation (only startup-cpu-boost=true, autoscaling min/maxScale, client metadata) -- meaning Cloud Run's DEFAULT behavior applies: CPU is allocated only while a request is actively being served; `void runSitePlanExportJob(...)` (the detached background call P-240 introduced) runs AFTER the HTTP response already returned 202, with no guarantee of CPU. This directly reopens the dispatch's own dismissal ('it was hypothesised by the planner and REFUTED... it had CPU throughout') -- that refutation's own logic does not hold: wall-clock time elapsing does not prove CPU was allocated; throttled CPU still lets time pass, just far slower for CPU-bound work inside it.
